info.title: MY GARB PHASONABLE Backend
info.description: MY GARB foundation and authentication. Register customer/designer accounts, then log in using an HttpOnly session cookie. Auth POSTs require JSON and X-MYGARB-Request: 1. Browser origins must be configured; cross-site fetches are rejected. Cookies use SameSite=Strict, Secure in production, and Path=/api. Sessions default to one hour and logout revokes the current session server-side. Login/register share 10 attempts per 15 minutes/IP. General API limit is 100/minute/IP; health probes are exempt. M3 adds owner profiles, designer portfolios, public discovery and private customer measurements. Every write requires JSON and X-MYGARB-Request: 1. No request/order sharing is implemented. M4 adds participant-only outfit requests, immutable measurement snapshots, recoverable confirmation and orders. Money is exact-decimal NGN; dates are UTC calendar dates. No payments or snapshot corrections.

patch.summary: Confirm proposal or recover its single order
patch.description: Owning customer only. Atomic accepted->confirmed intent with frozen proposal/snapshot and deterministic order ID equal to request ID; unique requestId order index and idempotent upsert prevent duplicates. First claim requires active designer and future proposal date. Retries return the same order without resetting its status/history/timestamps, even after deadline. If insertion fails after intent, return 503 CONFIRMATION_PENDING; GET request shows orderPending and retry this endpoint after recovery/restart. No transactions or background worker. No rollback to accepted after durable intent. Concurrent cancellation and confirmation have one winner.

patch.description: Assigned designer: confirmed->in_progress->ready. Owning customer: ready->completed. Same-state retry succeeds without appending history; jumps/backward changes fail. No money, snapshot, owner or history edits. Measurement corrections deferred to later messaging workflow; no payments.
